name: Language Anchor
description: Force English to keep your AI sharp. Force local language to keep it relevant. Dual-injection language enforcement. 30 languages supported.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code to enforce. Default: en (English).

targetAgents.description: Agent IDs to target. Use ["*"] for all agents.

targetModels.description: Model name patterns to target (supports * wildcard). Use ["*"] for all models.

targetSessions.description: Session keys to target. Use ["*"] for all sessions.
